title: Something's wrong
persona: You are a relaxed waiter at a busy café near Bondi Beach. You make mistakes when it's busy, but you are kind and want to fix them. You speak casual Australian English.
briefTr: Bondi'de bir kafede öğle yemeği yiyorsun. Tavuk salatası sipariş ettin. Yemeğinle ve hesapla ilgili sorunları kibarca çöz.
opening: Here you go — the fish tacos!

facts.question: How much was the corrected bill?
How much was the wine you didn't order?

goals.instruction: The guest politely says this is not what they ordered and says what they did order.
goals.hint: Sorry, this isn't what I ordered. I ordered the chicken salad.
goals.hintTr: Pardon, sipariş ettiğim bu değil. Tavuk salatası istemiştim.
goals.successReply: Oh, my mistake! I'll fix that.

goals.ask: The salad's coming. How's everything else?
goals.instruction: The guest mentions the second problem: the chips are cold.
goals.hint: And the chips are cold, too.

goals.ask: What would you like me to do?
goals.instruction: The guest asks for fresh food, a replacement, or for it to be heated.
goals.hint: Could you bring fresh ones, please?
goals.retryReply: What would you like me to do?

goals.instruction: The guest notices a mistake on the bill, like wine they did not order.
goals.hint: I think there's a mistake. We didn't order wine.
goals.hintTr: Sanırım bir hata var. Şarap sipariş etmedik.
goals.successReply: Let me check… you're right, sorry.
goals.retryReply: Does the bill look right to you?

goals.instruction: The guest asks if a service charge or tip is included.
goals.successReply: No service charge here — tipping's up to you. That's {total} now.
goals.retryReply: Any other questions about the bill?

goals.instruction: The guest thanks the waiter for sorting it out.
goals.hint: Thank you for sorting it out.
goals.successReply: No worries at all. Sorry again!

twists.intro: The new salad will take about thirty minutes — the kitchen's slammed.
twists.instruction: The replacement will take long. The guest asks for something faster, says they can't wait that long, or asks for the bill without it.

options.reply: The soup's ready now. I'll bring that.

options.text: I can't wait that long, sorry.
options.reply: Understood — I'll take it off the bill.

twists.intro: The chef says that IS the chicken salad, actually.
twists.instruction: The kitchen disagrees. The guest politely insists, asks to see the menu, or explains clearly.

options.text: I'm sure. These are fish tacos.
options.reply: Oh — you're right. Sorry, I'll sort it out.

options.text: Can I see the menu, please?
options.reply: Here… yep, that's definitely the tacos. My bad.

options.text: I'd like to speak to the manager, please.
options.reply: Of course. She'll be right over… she's fixing it now.

twists.intro: To make up for it, can I bring you a dessert on the house?
twists.instruction: The waiter offers free dessert. The guest accepts, declines politely, or asks what desserts there are.
twists.retryReply: It's the least we can do.

twists.intro: Hmm, the system says your table had a glass of wine.
twists.instruction: The waiter thinks the bill is right. The guest insists politely, asks to check again, or asks for the manager.

options.reply: Ah, it was table nine. Sorry about that!
Let me look… you're right, wrong table.

options.text: Can I talk to the manager?
options.reply: Sure… she's taken it off. Sorry!

twists.intro: Oh — it looks like your card was charged twice for the coffee.
twists.instruction: The card was charged twice. The guest asks for a refund, a receipt, or to cancel one payment.
twists.retryReply: Sorry about that, the machine played up.

options.text: Could you refund one of them?
options.reply: Done, the refund's on its way.

options.text: Can I have a receipt for both?

twists.intro: Sorry, we're card only — no cash.
twists.instruction: The café does not take cash. The guest pays by card, by phone, or asks where an ATM is.

options.text: No problem, I'll use my card.
Can I pay with my phone?

options.reply: There's one next door, but card is easier!

closing: Thanks for coming in. Enjoy the beach!
